clues.it: Luca era nella 4ª colonna, nella 1ª riga, in una stanza diversa da Vito e nella Hall.
clues.en: Luca was in the 4th column, in the 1st row, in a different room from Vito and in the Lobby.

clues.it: Carla era accanto a un grammofono e in una stanza diversa da Vito.
clues.en: Carla was beside a gramophone and in a different room from Vito.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 11ª colonna e accanto a una palma in vaso o a un pianoforte a coda.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 11th column and beside a potted palm or a grand piano.

clues.it: Marta era nella 4ª riga e nella Hall, ma non era accanto a il bancone della reception.
clues.en: Marta was in the 4th row and in the Lobby, but was not beside the reception desk.

clues.it: Irene era a ovest di Bruno.
Rosa era nella 7ª colonna e nella 6ª riga, ma non era accanto a un tavolo da biliardo.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 7th column and in the 6th row, but was not beside a billiard table.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 6ª colonna e nella 7ª riga, ma non era accanto a un baule da viaggio.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 6th column and in the 7th row, but was not beside a steamer trunk.

clues.it: Giada era nella 9ª colonna, accanto a un tavolo da biliardo o a un tappeto persiano e a un tappeto persiano.
clues.en: Giada was in the 9th column, beside a billiard table or a persian carpet and a persian carpet.

clues.it: Vito era nella 10ª colonna, esattamente una riga a nord di Bruno e al Ristorante.
clues.en: Vito was in the 10th column, exactly one row north of Bruno and in the Restaurant.

clues.it: Bruno era accanto a un pianoforte a coda e nella stessa stanza di Olga.
clues.en: Bruno was beside a grand piano and in the same room as Olga.

clues.it: Tea era nella 11ª riga, a ovest di Carla e da sola nella Sala da Ballo.
clues.en: Tea was in the 11th row, west of Carla and alone in the Ballroom.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

steps.en: Luca can only be in the 4th column: ruling it out leaves Tea a single square: row 11th, column 2nd.
